Class GameOptions

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Options
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents the collection of all game options available in the current context. Provides methods to enumerate, search, and access individual game options.

public class GameOptions : MemoryAddressContainer, IEnumerable<GameOption>, IEnumerable
